source: James Buchanan had a lot of experience in government. Abraham Lincoln didn't. So what if I'm a little unseasoned? I have the instincts for the job.
zh: 詹姆斯布坎南在政府部门拥有丰富的经验。亚伯拉罕·林肯没有。如果我有点缺乏经验怎么办？我有这份工作的直觉。

source: Dick Cheney is a principled conservative leader. The two of us will govern over a conservative, patriotic administration. Let's turn the page from the Clinton era.
zh: 迪克·切尼是一位有原则的保守派领袖。我们两人将领导一个保守、爱国的政府。让我们从克林顿时代翻过这一页。

source: Dick Cheney is the best person for the job. He has served in all kinds of roles and performed admirably in every case.
zh: 迪克·切尼是这项工作的最佳人选。他曾担任过各种角色，并且在每一个案件中都表现出色。

source: This is a good, conservative answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
zh: 这是一个很好的、保守的答案，可以激励你的基础。一如既往，确保你在撤军和吸引犹豫不决的选民之间找到适当的平衡。

source: This is a good, mainstream answer. As always, make sure you balance the need to win moderates against the desires of your core supporters.
zh: 这是一个很好的主流答案。一如既往，确保在赢得温和派的需要与核心支持者的愿望之间取得平衡。

source: You're certainly getting attention in the news for this stance, but it is not a mainstream position in your party. Perhaps this will establish you as an independent thinker...
zh: 您的这一立场肯定会引起新闻关注，但这并不是您所在政党的主流立场。也许这会让你成为一个独立的思想家......

source: It's important to stick to your principles, but your answer is not calibrated to win a majority of voters in November.
zh: 坚持你的原则很重要，但你的答案并没有经过调整以赢得 11 月的大多数选民。

source: A lot of people say that Social Security is the third rail of American politics. You may have made some hard-core conservatives happy, but the vast majority of voters disagree with your stance.
zh: 很多人说社会保障是美国政治的第三轨。你可能让一些顽固的保守派感到高兴，但绝大多数选民不同意你的立场。

source: Foreign policy is not a huge issue in this election. Just avoid saying anything too hawkish or dovish so that you don't attract negative attention.
zh: 外交政策在这次选举中并不是一个大问题。只是避免说过于鹰派或鸽派的话，以免引起负面关注。

source: This is a good, mainstream answer on foreign policy.
zh: 这是关于外交政策的一个很好的主流答案。

source: You are getting your core voters fired up, but it might be better not to mention Bill Clinton. He's a popular figure in America and you are trying to unseat his heir apparent.
zh: 你正在让你的核心选民兴奋起来，但最好不要提及比尔·克林顿。他在美国是一位受欢迎的人物，而你正试图推翻他的法定继承人。

source: For a Republican, there's nothing wrong with giving a pat phrase and moving to the next topic when it comes to Bill Clinton.
zh: 对共和党人而言，谈到比尔·克林顿时，讲几句套话就转向下一个话题，并无不妥。

source: The Elian issue is simple -- a small, politically active minority in Florida wants him to remain. There is also the issue of supporting or opposing Bill Clinton to consider.
zh: 埃利安问题很简单——佛罗里达州中一小部分政治活跃的少数派希望他留下来。还有支持或反对比尔·克林顿的问题需要考虑。

source: Support and opposition to the Serbia air strikes is all over the place. Mainstream politicians support the action, while a combination of anti-war leftists and anti-Clinton Republicans oppose it.
zh: 对塞尔维亚空袭的支持和反对无处不在。主流政客支持这一行动，而反战左翼人士和反克林顿共和党人则反对。

source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Buchanan or even Gore.
zh: 什么？！你很快澄清了这一说法，但为时已晚。你已经严重损害了你在基础选民中的信誉，并且可能失去了很多选票给布坎南甚至戈尔。

source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
zh: 美国人普遍对比尔·克林顿有不错的看法，你的答案可能不太适合时代。然而，这肯定会激励你的保守派基础。

source: Americans generally have a decent opinion of Bill Clinton and Al Gore, and your answer might not fit the times that well. However, it will definitely motivate your conservative base.
zh: 美国人普遍对比尔·克林顿和阿尔·戈尔有不错的看法，你的答案可能不太适合时代。然而，这肯定会激励你的保守派基础。

source: This is a theme that will establish you as a moderate, mainstream conservative. To run a national campaign against a popular Administration, this might be the right tone to strike.
zh: 这个主题将使您成为温和的主流保守派。要开展一场全国性的运动来反对一个受欢迎的政府，这可能是正确的打击基调。

source: Americans dislike partisan rancor, but is your speech the answer? What are the details? You also have to worry about alienating conservative supporters.
zh: 美国人不喜欢党派仇恨，但你的演讲就是答案吗？详情为何？你还必须担心疏远保守派支持者。

source: It is probably a bad idea to run against the record of Bill Clinton, given his popularity. Better to just ignore him and focus on other issues.
zh: 考虑到比尔·克林顿的受欢迎程度，与他的记录竞争可能是一个坏主意。最好忽略他并专注于其他问题。

source: Ignoring Clinton is a good idea, and the rest of this strategy establishes your conservative bona fides. It could be interesting.
zh: 忽略克林顿是个好主意，该策略的其余部分将建立您保守的诚意。这可能很有趣。

source: It is risky to run an overtly negative campaign after the recent Clinton-Gingrich battles. It might be better to focus on your own plans for government.
zh: 在最近的克林顿-金里奇战斗之后进行公开的负面战役是有风险的。最好专注于你自己的政府计划。

source: This is a good strategy, if the goal is moving past the Clinton years and presenting yourself as an acceptable mainstream leader.
zh: 如果目标是超越克林顿岁月并将自己呈现为可接受的主流领导者，那么这是一个很好的策略。

source: Alright. Way to get that crowd fired up.
zh: 好的。让那群人兴奋起来的方法。

source: Hopefully you can pull Florida out and win the election. Good luck!
zh: 希望你能把佛罗里达州拉出来并赢得选举。祝你好运！

source: Hopefully you can pull Ohio and Pennsylvania out and win the election. Good luck!
zh: 希望你能把俄亥俄州和宾夕法尼亚州拉出来并赢得选举。祝你好运！

source: Hopefully you can pull these states out and win the election. Good luck!
zh: 希望你能把这些州拉出来并赢得选举。祝你好运！

source: This is widely seen as a poor response to the news that broke. Hopefully you can still win the election.
zh: 这被广泛认为是对突发新闻的不良反应。希望你仍然能赢得选举。

source: Your response struck some as too passive and apologetic. Definitely not in character for a potential world leader.
zh: 你的回应让一些人觉得过于被动和抱歉。绝对不符合潜在世界领导人的性格。

source: This is probably the best you could do under the circumstances. Good luck!
zh: 这可能是在这种情况下你能做的最好的事情。祝你好运！

source: Americans want to hear you address this personally, and not watch as you hide behind a spokeswoman.
zh: 美国人希望听到您亲自解决这个问题，而不是看着您躲在发言人后面。

source: Many people are questioning your credibility and fitness based on this issue. There are too many sources and witnesses for you to deny these things completely.
zh: 很多人基于这个问题质疑你的可信度和健康度。有太多的消息来源和证人让你无法完全否认这些事情。

source: This is probably the best response you can give, given some of these things that happened when you were young and immature.
zh: 考虑到您年轻且不成熟时发生的一些事情，这可能是您能给出的最佳回应。

source: It might be better to admit that something happened and address it.
zh: 承认发生了一些事情并解决它可能会更好。

source: This is a good, solid response to the question.
zh: 这是对这个问题的良好、可靠的回答。

source: Interesting answer, though a few people are mumbling about you comparing yourself to Lincoln.
zh: 有趣的答案，尽管有些人在嘀咕你将自己与林肯进行比较。

source: This is a good, liberal answer that will motivate your base. As always, make sure you find the right balance between getting your troops out and appealing to undecided voters.
zh: 这是一个很好、自由的答案，可以激励你的基础。一如既往，确保你在撤军和吸引犹豫不决的选民之间找到适当的平衡。

source: What?! You quickly clarify this statement, but it is too late. You have massively damaged your credibility with your base, and have probably lost a lot of votes to Nader or even Bush.
zh: 什么？！你很快澄清了这一说法，但为时已晚。你已经严重损害了你在基础选民中的信誉，并且可能失去了很多选票给纳德甚至布什。

source: It would probably be better not to repudiate Clinton so harshly. Not only is he broadly popular, but you also served with him for eight years.
zh: 最好不要如此严厉地否认克林顿。他不仅广受欢迎，而且您还与他一起服役了八年。

source: It is a net positive that you are embracing Clinton's legacy. Just keep in mind that there's a trade-off -- some left-wing voters believe that Clinton is too moderate.
zh: 您正在接受克林顿的遗产，这是一个积极的结果。请记住，这是一个权衡——一些左翼选民认为克林顿过于温和。

source: It does not look good for Al Gore, noted environmentalist, to come out against the Kyoto Protocol.
zh: 著名的环保主义者阿尔·戈尔站出来反对《京都议定书》，这看起来不太好。

source: This is a good hedge. Even John Kerry voted against the Protocol.
zh: 这是一个很好的对冲。甚至约翰·克里也投票反对该协议。

source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. There's no reason to make an unforced error like this.
zh: 移民在这次选举中不是一个大问题。没有理由犯这样的非受迫性错误。

source: Interesting ideas, but immigration is not a big issue in this election. But no harm, no foul.
zh: 有趣的想法，但移民在这次选举中不是一个大问题。但没有伤害，没有犯规。

source: Immigration is not a big issue in this election. Better to just focus on your core platform.
zh: 移民在这次选举中不是一个大问题。最好只专注于您的核心政治纲领。

source: What?! The purpose of your candidacy is to provide a solid, left-wing alternative to the two main parties. People are wondering what you meant by taking this stance.
zh: 什么？！您参选的目的是为两个主要政党提供一个可靠的左翼替代方案。人们想知道你采取这种立场是什么意思。

source: This is a good, left-wing answer that will motivate your base.
zh: 这是一个很好的左翼答案，可以激励你的基础。

source: This is a good answer for a Green Party candidate.
zh: 对于绿党候选人来说，这是一个很好的答案。

source: The best course for a Green Party candidate is to oppose foreign intervention under almost all circumstances.
zh: 对于绿党候选人来说，最好的做法是在几乎所有情况下反对外国干预。

source: It's probably best to ignore Bill Clinton, and focus your statements on Bush, Gore, and the two-party system in general.
zh: 最好忽略比尔·克林顿，并将您的陈述集中在布什、戈尔和一般的两党制度上。

source: This stance helps you in a couple of coal states, but definitely raises eyebrows among the mainstream left.
zh: 这种立场对一些煤炭州有帮助，但肯定会引起主流左派的不满。

source: Today you have announced the selection of John Danforth as running mate. Can you speak more about him?
zh: 今天您宣布选择约翰·丹福思作为竞选搭档。你能多谈谈他吗？

source: Do you support the air strikes and sanctions that have been levied against Iraq, with the goal of weakening Saddam Hussein?
zh: 您是否支持对伊拉克实施空袭和制裁，以削弱萨达姆·侯赛因？

source: What is your opinion on the performance and conduct of our current President, Bill Clinton?
zh: 您对我们现任总统比尔·克林顿的表现和行为有何看法？

source: Should low-income parents be able to use federal vouchers to send their children to private schools?
zh: 低收入父母是否应该能够使用联邦代金券将孩子送到私立学校？

source: Do you have any plans to help America's seniors better pay for vital prescription drugs?
zh: 您是否有计划帮助美国老年人更好地支付重要的处方药费用？

source: I don't think we need to make huge changes to a system that works for the majority of the people it is supposed to help.
zh: 我认为我们不需要对一个适用于大多数应该帮助的人的系统进行巨大的改变。

source: I believe we should address this problem directly -- by adding a prescription drug benefit to Medicare.
zh: 我认为我们应该直接解决这个问题——通过在联邦医疗保险中添加处方药福利。

source: We need more funding for Medicare. We need to hold providers accountable when they fall short, by curbing excess profits for pharmaceuticals and targeting HMOs that drop seniors.
zh: 我们需要更多资金用于联邦医疗保险。我们需要通过限制药品的超额利润并针对导致老年人流失的健康维护组织（HMO），在供应商未能达标时追究其责任。

source: We should incorporate Medicare into a larger, universal single-payer health insurance program. Many proposals I hear about are overly cautious and lacking in ambition.
zh: 我们应该将联邦医疗保险纳入一个更大的、通用的单一付款人健康保险计划。我听到的许多建议都过于谨慎且缺乏雄心。

source: I believe we haven't gone far enough on this issue. Saddam Hussein is a destabilizing leader, and he must be removed for the Middle East to truly prosper.
zh: 我相信我们在这个问题上做得还不够。萨达姆·侯赛因是一位破坏稳定的领导人，必须将他赶下台，中东才能真正繁荣。

source: We are following the right course in Iraq. We must enforce our agreement to prevent Saddam from acquiring weapons of mass destruction. Saddam is allowing the sanctions to harm his people for his own selfish purposes.
zh: 我们在伊拉克走的是正确的道路。我们必须执行我们的协议，防止萨达姆获取大规模杀伤性武器。萨达姆为了自己的自私目的而允许制裁伤害他的人民。

source: The United States is much too entangled in the Middle East. We should pull back from the region and end sanctions in Iraq. I might remind people that these sanctions have killed hundreds of thousands of Iraqi children.
zh: 美国在中东问题上纠缠得太深了。我们应该从该地区撤军并结束对伊拉克的制裁。我可能会提醒人们，这些制裁已经导致数十万伊拉克儿童死亡。

source: I see how this is appealing to some conservatives, but it still represents the interference of the federal government in education.
zh: 我看到这对一些保守派来说很有吸引力，但它仍然代表了联邦政府对教育的干预。

source: I strongly support this idea and will work to implement it as President. All parents deserve to choose where their child will attend school.
zh: 我强烈支持这个想法，并将作为总统努力实现它。所有父母都有权选择孩子上学的地方。

source: This plan will take money out of the public schools and will not fix the underlying problem of poor education in the United States.
zh: 该计划将从公立学校中抽走资金，并且不会解决美国教育质量差的根本问题。

source: My campaign isn't about Bill Clinton. I prefer to focus on the future, and on the issues that will strengthen our country and economy.
zh: 我的广告系列与比尔·克林顿无关。我更喜欢关注未来，关注那些能够增强我们国家和经济实力的问题。

source: Bill Clinton's partisan attacks have degraded the political culture of our country. I will be a uniter, not a divider, when I am in the White House.
zh: 比尔·克林顿的党派攻击已经退化了我们国家的政治文化。当我在白宫中时，我将成为一个团结者，而不是一个分裂者。

source: Bill Clinton pushed through a tax increase, new gun control laws, a lot of environmental regulations, and has been subject to numerous fundraising and corruption allegations. Not to mention his infamous personal conduct in the White House.
zh: 比尔·克林顿推动通过了增税、新的枪支管制法和大量环境法规，并受到了大量筹款和腐败指控。更不用说他在白宫中臭名昭著的个人行为。

source: We can all learn a lot from Bill Clinton's ability to compromise with Congress and pursue a moderate political agenda. I will do the same as President.
zh: 我们都可以从比尔·克林顿与国会妥协并追求温和政治议程的能力中学到很多东西。我也会像总统那样做。

source: John Danforth is a strong, religious man with a good heart. He is a wonderful example of a leader that conservatives can produce.
zh: 约翰·丹福思是一个坚强、虔诚、心地善良的人。他是保守派可以培养的领导人的绝佳典范。

source: John Danforth has served his home state of Missouri well. I think he has a record that all Americans can get behind.
zh: 约翰·丹福思很好地服务了他的家乡密苏里州。我认为他拥有所有美国人都可以追随的记录。

source: The consensus view is that the U.S. should continue to strike foreign terrorist networks. Voters don't want to see a U.S. pullback, nor do they wish to see a large-scale conflict or ground invasion.
zh: 共识是美国应该继续打击外国恐怖网络。选民不希望看到美国撤军，也不希望看到大规模冲突或地面入侵。

source: This is a good idea for dealing with any issues or questions relating to Bill Clinton.
zh: 这是处理与比尔·克林顿相关的任何问题或疑问的好主意。

source: A lot of moderates blame Republicans as much as or more than Bill Clinton for the partisanship of the 1990s.
zh: 许多温和派对 20 世纪 90 年代党派之争的指责与比尔·克林顿一样多，甚至更多。
